[Story]
Li Ming is a resident who cares about the community, he plants a precious fruit tree in the community park, but he forgets to water the fruit tree. Wang Gang mistakenly thinks this tree is a sick tree, decides to cut it down to prevent the disease from spreading. Zhao Li is Li Ming's neighbor, she sees Wang Gang's behavior, but because she has a personal grudge with Li Ming, she keeps silent. When Li Ming finds out the tree is cut, he feels very sad, and starts to ask people around. In the end, Wang Gang realizes he may have misjudged the situation.

[Question]
What is the possible intention of Zhao Li not stopping Wang Gang's behavior?

[Candidate Answers]
A. Zhao Li may think that Wang Gang realizes his mistake and corrects it on his own.
B. Zhao Li may choose not to intervene because she is afraid of conflict with Wang Gang.
C. Zhao Li may choose not to interfere because she thinks Wang Gang's behavior is reasonable.
D. Zhao Li may be out of revenge, hoping to cause trouble for Li Ming.
